findings.title: The carried Guardrails requirement's SHALL still covers explore and keeps its lines
findings.description: The walk carried `Restated Guardrails lines are removed from orbit-modified bodies` to point explore's lines at their own edit, but only its sourcing sentence changed. Its SHALL still reads: remove "from an orbit-modified body's upstream `**Guardrails**` list each line that a step line of the same body states … and SHALL keep every other line". Explore is an orbit-modified body, and none of its five removed lines is stated by a step line (the opening paragraph and stance bullets state them), so the SHALL read alone requires keeping them, while `orbit-explore-modifications` removes them. The two owners still state different rules for one list. Also cosmetic: the carried block opens with two blank lines after its heading.
findings.recommendation: Scope the SHALL itself: "…from an orbit-modified body's upstream `**Guardrails**` list, explore's excepted (`orbit-explore-modifications`' `Upstream explore stance preserved` names its lines), each line that …", and drop the doubled blank line.
